name: markdown-allowed-subset
body: Bodies accept: blocks — paragraphs; Markdown subheadings `##` and `###`, but only where the enclosing template declares no child sections (a heading at any depth 1–6 is a section marker when the enclosing template declares child sections — slide-sections, template-composition); bulleted and numbered lists (max one nesting level); inline — core CommonMark bold, italic, inline code, `[]()` links, hard line breaks. `#` is reserved for section markers.
